Job Description:        Job Family Definition: Designs, implements, and supports enterprise network security controls that protect connectivity across corporate, data center, cloud, and laboratory environments. Maintains firewall policy integrity, remediates security risks, supports network segmentation, and partners with security and infrastructure teams to deliver resilient, compliant network services.  The Network Security Engineer provides engineering and operational support for enterprise firewall and network segmentation services. The role maintains effective security policies, drives risk remediation, supports Juniper network segmentation engineering and Network Security Policy Management (NSPM) capabilities, and ensures firewall changes are implemented securely and consistently across the enterprise, including Local Risk / lab environments.      Responsibilities:    Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise firewalls and associated security policies.  Improve firewall policy hygiene by identifying and remediating unused, duplicate, overly permissive, expired, or noncompliant rules and objects.  Assess and remediate network security risks across enterprise environments, including Local Risk laboratory environments.  Support Juniper network segmentation engineering, including policy design, implementation, validation, and troubleshooting.  Support firewall policy change management by reviewing requests, assessing risk, validating technical requirements, coordinating implementation, and confirming outcomes.  Contribute to NSPM implementation, integration, rule analysis, workflow enablement, reporting, and operational adoption.  Develop and maintain advanced Layer 7 application-aware policies aligned with business access requirements and security standards.  Investigate connectivity and policy enforcement issues using logs, packet captures, flow data, and related diagnostic tools.  Collaborate with network, cloud, application, security operations, risk, and change-management teams to resolve incidents and deliver secure solutions.  Maintain technical documentation, including network diagrams, firewall standards, operating procedures, implementation plans, and test evidence.   Education and Experience Required:   University degree in information technology, cybersecurity, networking, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.  Hands-on experience configuring, administering, or supporting enterprise firewalls and network security technologies.  Experience with firewall policy governance, change management, risk remediation, or network segmentation in a production environment.   Knowledge, Competencies and Skills:   6 or more years of experience working knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, subnetting, network address translation, DNS, VPNs, and common application protocols.  Practical knowledge of stateful firewalls, access control models, security zones, objects, rule bases, and policy lifecycle management.  Understanding of advanced Layer 7 firewall capabilities, including application identification, user-aware controls, URL filtering, SSL inspection, intrusion prevention, and threat prevention.  Familiarity with Juniper firewall and network segmentation technologies.  Understanding of NSPM platforms and their use in policy analysis, rule recertification, risk identification, change workflows, compliance, and reporting.  Ability to use correlated operational and security tools, such as network monitoring, logging, SIEM, vulnerability management, configuration management, and ticketing platforms.  Basic scripting or automation knowledge for policy analysis, reporting, configuration validation, or repetitive operational tasks.  Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to translate business connectivity requirements into secure technical policies.  Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate across global technical, security, and business teams.  Relevant networking or security certification, such as Juniper, Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet, or ISC2 CISSP, is preferred.
